name: Block
description: Brace for the incoming blow. Reduces damage this turn.

name: Rest
description: Recover 24 stamina, but leave yourself open.

name: Hook
description: Heavy side shot. Good against patient opponents.

name: Uppercut
description: High-risk power punch with knockdown potential.

name: Haymaker
description: Huge damage. Leaves you exhausted if it misses.

name: Body Shot
description: Damages opponent stamina as well as health.

name: Overhand Right
description: A looping shot that can crack a guard.

name: Counter
description: Strong only when you correctly read the enemy tell.

name: Slip
description: Guaranteed evade against the next incoming attack.

name: Feint
description: Disrupt the opponent's tell and lower their next accuracy.

name: Clinch
description: Break a combo and recover a little stamina.

name: Headbutt
description: Dirty damage with a chance of disqualification.

name: Low Blow
description: Huge stamina damage; high disqualification risk.
